scores.notes: Both show a round pit of pale grey stone blocks with a sandy floor, dry brush and palms at the rim and a stair at the back leading up out of the pit, all in daylight. The torch and wooden door appear only on the right, which fits a different viewpoint.

Daniel being lifted on the left and Daniel standing before the throne on the right are both an older man with short grey hair, a short grey beard and a lean face, wearing a blue cloak over a white robe.
Daniel in the banquet hall on the left and the small figure in the centre of the den on the right both have short grey hair and a grey beard on a lean, older face, with the same blue cloak.
Daniel on the rope at the pit's edge on the left and Daniel with his hand raised on the right are both an older man with short grey hair, a trimmed grey beard and a lean face.
Daniel in the hall on the left has short grey hair and a grey beard. The small Daniel in the centre of the pit on the right has dark hair and a dark beard and looks younger.
Daniel being lifted on the left has grey hair and a grey beard. Daniel standing among the lions on the right has close-cropped dark hair and a short dark beard on a younger face.
Daniel among the lions on the left has close-cropped dark hair and a dark beard and looks younger. Daniel in the hall on the right has short grey hair, a grey beard and an older face.
Daniel in the hall on the left and Daniel being lifted in the pit on the right both have short grey hair and a grey beard on a lean, older face, with the same blue cloak.
Daniel in the pit on the left has dark hair and a dark beard. Daniel on the rope on the right has white-grey hair and a white beard and looks clearly older.

The left pit has dark slate-grey walls, a full-height iron gate at floor level between buttresses, and palace buildings behind under a grey sky. The right pit has paler stone, a small barred opening above a short stone stair under a wooden canopy, and palms with a bright sky.
Daniel on the rope on the left and Daniel on the balcony on the right are both an older man with short grey hair and a short grey beard, wearing a blue cloak over a white robe.
Daniel on the balcony on the left has short grey hair and a grey beard on an older face. The small Daniel in the pit on the right has dark hair and a dark beard.
The small Daniel in the centre of the den on the left and Daniel being lifted on the right both have short grey hair and a grey beard on an older, lean face, with a blue cloak over a white robe.
Both show a round pit of pale stone with a round, iron-banded wooden lid over a barred gate in the wall, sandy ground, dry brush and palms, all in daylight.

Daniel in the hall on the left and Daniel on the balcony on the right share short grey hair, a short grey beard and the same lean, older face. The small difference in skin tone fits the warm night lighting on the right.
